description: Two users, one prompt: the same template (local.greet@1.0.0) instantiated with each user's `with` gives two concrete documents with different art_ and different results (output_hash = sha256 of each stdout, "Hola, Ana\n" and "Hello, Lee\n", computed outside the kernels when this vector was written). Covers the templates-with-`with` half of the row; inheritance along the .jos/ chain is covered by the dir-* vectors and user claims in the Capability by the capability group.
promise: P40: "Nano-personalization: two users, same prompt, different result" (nano-intentions, Jos). 2.0: directory inheritance + user claims in the Capability + templates with `with`. Phase F1.
